response.sql: SELECT r."name" AS "name", AVG(cs."wins") AS "avg_wins" FROM "constructorStandings" cs JOIN "races" r ON r."raceId" = cs."raceId" WHERE cs."points" >= 6.0 GROUP BY r."name";

assumptions.assumption: The average is taken over constructor standing entries (one per constructor per race) that pass the points filter, not over distinct constructors, and AVG skips NULL wins so a race whose kept entries all have NULL wins returns NULL.
Points are compared with >= 6.0 on each entry's season-to-date points value, as the verified description states, and entries with NULL points are excluded because NULL fails the comparison.
